bd-1nr0.title: Landscape: huge rice fields, nothing else in view
bd-1nr0.summary: Vast rice fields with almost nothing else around, in the border area between the centre, the north-centre and the north-east.

bd-3PQu.title: Rice: medium-height green rice
bd-3PQu.summary: Rice halfway through growing is taller but still green. Found in the north-west, the south and the south-east.

bd-8xfH.title: Coverage: scooter with left mirror and hair visible
bd-8xfH.summary: A scooter-mounted camera where mostly the left mirror and some hair are visible, on one southern island.

bd-BSuF.title: Coverage: Gen 4 with 2023 copyright label
bd-BSuF.summary: Gen 4 coverage labelled 2023 is found in the north-west, west, south-west, south, north-east and less often the south-east. 2024 and 2025 make up about half of all dates and appear everywhere.

bd-CFUU.title: Crops: corn in the west
bd-CFUU.summary: Corn is planted mostly in the west: large and medium fields in the west, north-west, north-centre and north of the south-west. Small patches also in the far south.

bd-DzsR.title: Houses: tin roofs
bd-DzsR.summary: Tin roofs are common. Many humid South and Southeast Asian countries use them too.

bd-HFxK.title: Houses: rare tiled roofs on the western border
bd-HFxK.summary: Tiled roofs are uncommon. The few you see come from the neighbouring Indian region and appear only near the south-west border.

bd-N0NE.title: Google car: Gen 3, guard holding a hayfork
bd-N0NE.summary: In one north-eastern city, a guard often stands by the car, usually holding a hayfork. Only in Gen 3.

bd-OTxD.title: Google car: Gen 4 with a smoky look
bd-OTxD.summary: Gen 4 coverage often has a smoky, hazy feel.

bd-OXUJ.title: Google car: Gen 3 red-barred mirror, white or striped
bd-OXUJ.summary: Gen 3 shows three cars: one with red mirrors with bars, a plain white one, and a striped white one. Only the plain white one exists elsewhere. Don't confuse the striped one with Cambodia's.

differs.how: Cambodia has a similar-looking striped car

bd-QJgl.title: Plants: tall eucalyptus with ivory trunks
bd-QJgl.summary: Tall trees with lush crowns and ivory-coloured trunks. They are more common in the north, especially the north-west, west and north-centre.

bd-QXjW.title: Plants: lone fruit trees, orchards at the border
bd-QXjW.summary: Stand-alone fruit trees are most common in the north-west and west. Planned orchards with rows of trees sit near the Indian border in both.

bd-RhN6.title: Plants: roadside trees with white-painted trunks
bd-RhN6.summary: Streets are lined with trees, some with white paint on the bottom of the trunk.

bd-SRni.title: Crops: sunflower fields in the far south
bd-SRni.summary: Sunflower fields appear in the south of one southern division.

bd-Sapn.title: Coverage: walker camera with black cover
bd-Sapn.summary: A walker camera with a black cover appears in one south-western city.

bd-TP6E.title: Roadside: water and farm fields
bd-TP6E.summary: Ponds, rivers and farm fields line the streets.

bd-V57y.title: Coverage: poor-quality black or white car
bd-V57y.summary: Some coverage is of very poor quality, filmed from a black or white car. Sometimes a big round blur hides the car colour completely.

bd-Wghx.title: Rice: beige, cut-down harvested fields
bd-Wghx.summary: Harvested rice looks beige or brown and cut short. It sits beside tall rice and fresh seedlings. Most common in the north-east and south-west.

bd-YtNI.title: Google car: Gen 3 white car, capital to port city
bd-YtNI.summary: Gen 3 coverage with the white car is in the capital, the big port city, and the highway between them.

bd-ZrT6.title: Plants: trees in blossom, spring coverage
bd-ZrT6.summary: Blossoming trees show up only where coverage was filmed in spring: the south-west, north-centre and southern part of the centre. Only reliable in Gen 4.

bd-aF5y.title: Coverage: walker camera with red mirrors
bd-aF5y.summary: A walker camera with red colour in its mirrors, found only on one small island.

bd-axpH.title: Rice: tall yellow-orange rice with fluffy tips
bd-axpH.summary: Fully grown rice is much taller, yellow or orange, with fluffy tips that show it is ripe. Mostly in the west, also the north-west and south-east.

bd-cdPX.title: Google car: Gen 4 black car or white car
bd-cdPX.summary: Gen 4 coverage shows either a black car or a white car.

bd-dQuW.title: Landscape: tea gardens in the highlands
bd-dQuW.summary: Tea is grown mainly in the highlands of the south of the north-east, and rarely in the south-east.

bd-e42R.title: Coverage: Gen 4 with 2022 copyright label
bd-e42R.summary: Gen 4 coverage labelled 2022 is found in the north-centre, the centre and less often the south-east. Labels rarely get updated without other changes.

bd-eLme.title: Language: Bengali script, line on top, triangle shapes
bd-eLme.summary: Bengali writing has a continuous line along the top of each word, like Hindi, but many letters have triangular shapes. It is also official in parts of eastern India.

bd-hqi8.title: Coverage: poor-quality camera only near the capital
bd-hqi8.summary: The poor-quality coverage exists only in and around the capital.

bd-iyC8.title: Bollard: red-and-white concrete, round or square
bd-iyC8.summary: Red-and-white concrete bollards across the whole country. They can be round or square.

bd-kiNu.title: Sign: black-and-white striped signposts
bd-kiNu.summary: Signposts often have black-and-white stripes. Sri Lanka, Bhutan, India, Nepal and Malaysia have them too, so check other clues.

bd-lm-793338.title: Rickshaw: angular fenders, painted bars on top
bd-lm-793338.summary: Roofed cycle rickshaws with angular fenders and painted metal bars on top, with the roof often folded back. Found in the north-centre division.

bd-lm-793339.title: Rickshaw: ornamented rear axle, heart or circle
bd-lm-793339.summary: Roofed cycle rickshaws with distinctive ornaments on the rear axle, either a simple upside-down heart or a fancier circle design. Only in the southern division.

bd-lm-793340.title: Rickshaw: chariot-like big passenger seat
bd-lm-793340.summary: Chariot-like cycle and auto rickshaws with a large passenger seat, found only between two towns in the centre.

bd-lm-793341.title: Rickshaw: several lines above rear axle
bd-lm-793341.summary: Roofed cycle rickshaws with multiple lines above the rear axle, in parts of the south-east and very common in its big port city.

bd-lm-793342.title: Rickshaw: cross bench, blue-red-yellow stripes
bd-lm-793342.summary: Cycle rickshaws with a bench across the cart, often striped blue, red and yellow. Between two towns in the centre.

bd-lm-793343.title: Rickshaw: flatbed with double rounded cross pattern
bd-lm-793343.summary: Flatbed rickshaws with quarter and semicircles forming a double rounded cross. In the east of the centre and across the border in the south-west.

bd-lm-793344.title: Vehicles: jeep-style utility trucks
bd-lm-793344.summary: Jeep-style utility vehicles appear mostly in the south-east, especially the hill tracts.

bd-lm-793345.title: Rickshaw: long benches, decorative back bars
bd-lm-793345.summary: Cycle rickshaws with long benches along the direction of travel and decorative metal bars at the back, north-west of one town in the north-west. No cross bench behind the driver.

bd-lm-793346.title: Rickshaw: long benches, no rear decoration
bd-lm-793346.summary: Cycle rickshaws with long benches and no rear decoration or cross bench, common in the north of the west and south-east of the north.

bd-lm-793347.title: Rickshaw: flatbed with long planks
bd-lm-793347.summary: Flatbed rickshaws with long planks along the direction of travel. Rare overall, but by far most common in the far north-west, and rarely in the north-centre near India.

bd-lm-793348.title: Rickshaw: metal cage-like frames
bd-lm-793348.summary: Pulled carts and cycle rickshaws with metal cage-like frames, common in the north-east and rare in the south-east.

bd-lm-793349.title: Rickshaw: U-shaped benches, wooden wheel extensions
bd-lm-793349.summary: Cycle rickshaws with two long benches and a cross bench in a U shape, plus wooden vertical extensions at both rear wheels. Only around one town in the far north.

bd-lm-793350.title: Rickshaw: flatbed, rectangular metal frame
bd-lm-793350.summary: Flatbed rickshaws with a rectangular metal frame under the driver's seat, common in the far north-west.

bd-lm-793351.title: Rickshaw: long benches, ridged roof
bd-lm-793351.summary: Cycle rickshaws with long benches and ridged roofs, used only on the island at the far southern tip.

bd-lm-793352.title: Rickshaw: flatbed with rounded cross pattern
bd-lm-793352.summary: Flatbed rickshaws with corner quarter circles forming a rounded cross. Often seen in the north of the south-west and in the west.

bd-lm-793353.title: Rickshaw: arched tunnel-like roof
bd-lm-793353.summary: Cycle rickshaws with arched, tunnel-like roofs over the driver's seat, used only in two separate areas in the south-west near the border.

bd-lm-793354.title: Rickshaw: two long benches and cross bench (U)
bd-lm-793354.summary: Cycle rickshaws with two long benches and a cross bench in a U formation, common in the east of the west and parts of the south of the north.

bd-lm-793355.title: Rickshaw: flatbed, wooden extensions over wheels
bd-lm-793355.summary: Flatbed rickshaws with horizontal wooden extensions above the rear wheels, mostly north-east of one town in the centre and parts of the north-centre.

bd-lm-793358.title: Rickshaw: auto rickshaw with bent roof bar
bd-lm-793358.summary: Many auto rickshaws in the north-centre have a metal bar over the front roof with a slight upward bend, sometimes with small metal balls. Other regions have similar bars but straight.

bd-lm-793359.title: Rickshaw: auto rickshaw with calligraphy and ornaments
bd-lm-793359.summary: Auto rickshaws around the south-east port city often have long Arabic calligraphy above the windshield, semicircular grill ornaments, and bulbous cage ornaments beside them. Seeing one or more is a good clue.

bd-lm-793360.title: Rickshaw: green auto with front painted another colour
bd-lm-793360.summary: Green auto rickshaws in part of the south-east often have all or half of the front painted yellow, red or blue. They are a majority only in this area.

bd-lm-793361.title: Rickshaw: grill ornament with two curled scrolls
bd-lm-793361.summary: A grill ornament with two curled scroll shapes appears north of the south-eastern port city. It is a fairly reliable clue even if placed elsewhere on the vehicle.

bd-lm-793362.title: Rickshaw: semicircle over onion-dome grill ornament
bd-lm-793362.summary: This grill ornament, a semicircle over an onion-dome shape, appears on electric auto rickshaws south of one southern city, between two rivers.

bd-lm-793363.title: Rickshaw: electric auto with VIP roof cover
bd-lm-793363.summary: A distinctive roof cover, usually saying VIP and in two or three colours, on electric auto rickshaws in the west and south of the north.

bd-lm-793364.title: Rickshaw: auto with Well Come or Welcome text
bd-lm-793364.summary: South and east of one north-eastern city, you often see auto rickshaws with Well Come or Welcome on the side of the roof.

bd-lwsk.title: Landscape: long east-west ridge on the northern border
bd-lwsk.summary: A big east-west ridge on the Indian border is visible from the north-east and eastern centre-north. Heavy haze often hides it.

bd-oHUw.title: Crops: tall green jute in the north-west
bd-oHUw.summary: Jute is a tall green crop, dried for rugs and bags. Because of when it was filmed, it appears almost only in the north-west. Dried jute hangs on fences or dries on roads anywhere.

bd-p7f4.title: Rice: short green rice barely above water
bd-p7f4.summary: Early-growth rice is short, green and barely out of the water. Seen in the south-west, centre-north and south of the big river near the capital. Only reliable in Gen 4 coverage.

bd-reel.title: Plants: thin drooping beach sheoaks on the coast
bd-reel.summary: Thin evergreen trees with long, drooping, thread-like branchlets, mostly along the south-east coast and around one coastal city.

bd-s4b7.title: Crops: low canola with yellow flowers
bd-s4b7.summary: Canola is low with yellow flowers. It is planted after rice, so it is very common in the centre, north of the big river.

bd-s4hQ.title: Plate: white, black or turquoise
bd-s4hQ.summary: Plates are white, black or turquoise. The turquoise plate exists only in this country.

bd-t28E.title: Coverage: walker camera escorted by security guard
bd-t28E.summary: A walker camera followed by a security guard, on the island at the far southern tip.

bd-tezx.title: Rice: empty off-season fields
bd-tezx.summary: Rice fields rest between crops, leaving barren empty fields. Mostly seen in the centre, north of the big river.

bd-tfmk.title: Coverage: guard beside the car in a southern city
bd-tfmk.summary: In one southern city, a guard can also stand by the car. Don't mix him up with the north-eastern one. The same man appears rarely in walker coverage elsewhere.

bd-vevQ.title: Google car: Gen 3 striped car, west of capital
bd-vevQ.summary: Gen 3 coverage with the striped car is mostly on yellow roads west of the capital.

bd-wFYz.title: Crops: watermelon fields in the far south
bd-wFYz.summary: Watermelon fields also appear in the south of the same southern division.

bd-wYSL.title: Landscape: tall forested hills in the far south-east
bd-wYSL.summary: Most of the country is almost flat, but the far south-east has fairly tall, forested, uncultivated hills.

bd-xIo2.title: Houses: west has hip roofs, east and centre mixed
bd-xIo2.summary: Roof styles split the country in two. The west and centre are mostly hip roofs of sheet metal, while the north and south-east tend to be mixed.

bd-xulk.title: Vehicles: rickshaws, especially green auto rickshaws
bd-xulk.summary: Rickshaws are everywhere, especially green motorised ones. Other Asian countries have them too.

bd-y9Ol.title: Houses: metal roof with triangular window below ridge
bd-y9Ol.summary: In the east, sheet metal roofs have a triangular window just under the ridge. The north-east has only this style. Also seen in the south-east, centre-north and parts of the north.
